leadership.name: Noël Busch-Armendariz, Ph.D., LMSW, MPA
leadership.title: Associate Dean for Global Engagement
leadership.secondaryTitle: University Presidential Professor; Director, Institute on Domestic Violence & Sexual Assault
leadership.bio: Dr. Busch-Armendariz leads the Office of Global Engagement and brings more than 40 years of international experience, including work in Albania, Dubai, England, India, Ireland, Lebanon, Scotland and South Korea and service in the Peace Corps in Romania. She has taught and supervised social work students abroad, including in Ghana and Mexico, and leads the School's Northern Ireland reconciliation program in partnership with Corrymeela, honored with UT's President's Award for Global Learning. She was named associate dean in June 2024.

leadership.name: Tanya Voss, LCSW
leadership.title: Assistant Dean for Global Engagement
leadership.bio: Professor Voss became assistant dean for global engagement in August 2023 after leading the School's practicum (field) education program for 17 years. She teaches the Global Practicum Seminar for international interns, co-leads the May Term course in London with Lauren Gulbas and serves as faculty advisor to Projects with Underserved Communities. She oversees the School's global practicum placements.

staff.name: Caitlin Sulley, LMSW
staff.title: Director of Research Operations
staff.secondaryTitle: Office of Global Engagement; Institute on Domestic Violence & Sexual Assault
staff.bio: Caitlin directs operations for the Office of Global Engagement, including research coordination, partnership agreements, communications and event planning. Her research and training background centers on multidisciplinary violence response and prevention and trauma-informed survivor engagement.
